questions.prompt: At which end should adding one begin?

choices.label: At the first, most-significant digit.
choices.feedback: Only the last digit increases initially; any overflow then carries leftward.

choices.label: At every digit simultaneously.

questions.prompt: What if a digit is nine while a carry reaches it?

choices.label: Write zero there and continue carrying to the digit on its left.
choices.feedback: A decimal digit cannot hold ten; its zero remains while one is carried into the next place.
